The callback signature is inferred from the expected function type.

package callbacks

import "net/http"

type store struct{}

func handler() {
	s := &store{}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /items", s.create) //@quickfix("create", re"has no field or method", http)
}
